title: Use Seedance 2.5 prompt-to-video with a storyboard reference token (e.g…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 prompt-to-video with a storyboard reference token (e.g., @[Imag]) and instruct it to start from panel 01 and follow all 14 panels in strict order for a coherent multi-shot sequence.  
Lock visual continuity by explicitly telling Seedance to keep the same medium/brushwork/texture/color grading/painterly finish consistent throughout the entire video.  
Prevent character drift by specifying “only the same mermaid” and listing identity locks (face, crown, hair, costume, tail, colors, proportions) to remain exact across all shots.  
Control scene consistency by requiring the video to remain entirely underwater and to preserve the exact environment elements from the storyboard (shipwreck, reefs, currents, particles, depth, lighting).  
Direct camera behavior by prompting “underwater action cinematographer” plus concrete moves (realistic underwater inertia, pursuit tracking, whip-pans, sweeping orbits, obstacle weaving, continuous focus).  
Improve pacing by defining per-shot timestamps and camera actions (Shot 01–14 with 0–30s timing) and specifying transition style changes (hard cuts for shots 1–8, smoother 9–10, slower cinematic transitions 11–14).  
Avoid unwanted lighting/style artifacts by adding explicit negatives like “No neon lighting or bioluminescent colors.”  
Generate the storyboard first with GPT Image 2 using a numbered 14-panel grid (3 rows x 5 columns) with thin black borders and panel numbers, then use it as the guide for Seedance video generation.

es.content:
Usa Seedance 2.5 prompt-to-video con un token de referencia de storyboard (por ejemplo, @[Imag]) e indícale que empiece desde el panel 01 y siga los 14 paneles en orden estricto para lograr una secuencia multishot coherente.  
Bloquea la continuidad visual indicándole explícitamente a Seedance que mantenga el mismo medio/brushwork/textura/color grading/acabado painterly de forma consistente durante todo el video.  
Evita la deriva del personaje especificando “only the same mermaid” y enumerando los bloqueos de identidad (rostro, corona, cabello, vestuario, cola, colores, proporciones) para que permanezcan exactos en todas las tomas.  
Controla la consistencia de la escena exigiendo que el video permanezca completamente underwater y que preserve los elementos exactos del entorno del storyboard (shipwreck, reefs, currents, particles, depth, lighting).  
Dirige el comportamiento de la cámara usando “underwater action cinematographer” junto con movimientos concretos (realistic underwater inertia, pursuit tracking, whip-pans, sweeping orbits, obstacle weaving, continuous focus).  
Mejora el ritmo definiendo timestamps por toma y acciones de cámara (Shot 01–14 con timing de 0–30s) y especificando cambios en el estilo de transición (hard cuts para las tomas 1–8, más suaves 9–10, transiciones cinematográficas más lentas 11–14).  
Evita artefactos no deseados de iluminación/estilo añadiendo negativos explícitos como “No neon lighting or bioluminescent colors.”  
Genera primero el storyboard con GPT Image 2 usando una cuadrícula numerada de 14 paneles (3 filas x 5 columnas) con bordes negros finos y números de panel, y luego úsalo como guía para la generación del video en Seedance.

fr.content:
Utilisez Seedance 2.5 prompt-to-video avec un token de référence de storyboard (par ex. @[Imag]) et demandez-lui de commencer au panneau 01 et de suivre les 14 panneaux dans l’ordre strict afin d’obtenir une séquence multi-plan cohérente.  
Verrouillez la continuité visuelle en indiquant explicitement à Seedance de conserver le même medium/brushwork/texture/color grading/painterly finish de manière cohérente tout au long de la vidéo.  
Évitez la dérive des personnages en précisant « only the same mermaid » et en listant les verrous d’identité (visage, couronne, cheveux, costume, queue, couleurs, proportions) qui doivent rester exacts dans tous les plans.  
Contrôlez la cohérence de la scène en exigeant que la vidéo reste entièrement underwater et qu’elle préserve les éléments exacts de l’environnement du storyboard (shipwreck, reefs, currents, particles, depth, lighting).  
Dirigez le comportement de la caméra en utilisant l’instruction « underwater action cinematographer » ainsi que des mouvements concrets (realistic underwater inertia, pursuit tracking, whip-pans, sweeping orbits, obstacle weaving, continuous focus).  
Améliorez le rythme en définissant des timestamps et des actions caméra par plan (Shot 01–14 avec un timing 0–30s) et en précisant les changements de style de transition (hard cuts pour les plans 1–8, transitions plus fluides 9–10, transitions cinématographiques plus lentes 11–14).  
Évitez les artefacts de lumière/style indésirables en ajoutant des négatifs explicites comme « No neon lighting or bioluminescent colors. »  
Générez d’abord le storyboard avec GPT Image 2 en utilisant une grille numérotée de 14 panneaux (3 rows x 5 columns) avec de fines bordures noires et des numéros de panneau, puis utilisez-le comme guide pour la génération vidéo avec Seedance.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 の prompt-to-video を、ストーリーボード参照トークン（例: @[Imag]）付きで使用し、panel 01 から開始して 14 の全パネルを厳密な順序で追うよう指示して、まとまりのあるマルチショットのシーケンスにします。  
Seedance に、同じ medium / brushwork / texture / color grading / painterly finish を動画全体で一貫して維持するよう明示的に伝え、visual continuity を固定します。  
キャラクターの drift を防ぐために、「only the same mermaid」と指定し、identity locks（face, crown, hair, costume, tail, colors, proportions）を列挙して、すべてのショットで完全に一致させます。  
シーンの一貫性を保つため、動画全体を完全に underwater にし、ストーリーボードにある環境要素（shipwreck, reefs, currents, particles, depth, lighting）を正確に保持するよう求めます。  
カメラの挙動は、「underwater action cinematographer」に加えて具体的な動き（realistic underwater inertia, pursuit tracking, whip-pans, sweeping orbits, obstacle weaving, continuous focus）を指示して制御します。  
ペース配分を改善するため、ショットごとの timestamps と camera actions（Shot 01–14 with 0–30s timing）を定義し、transition style の変化（shots 1–8 は hard cuts、9–10 はより滑らかに、11–14 は slower cinematic transitions）を指定します。  
「No neon lighting or bioluminescent colors.」のような明示的な negatives を追加して、不要な lighting/style artifacts を避けます。  
まず GPT Image 2 で、細い黒枠と panel numbers 付きの番号入り 14-panel grid（3 rows x 5 columns）として storyboard を生成し、それを Seedance の video generation のガイドとして使用します。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5의 prompt-to-video를 스토리보드 참조 토큰(예: @[Imag])과 함께 사용하고, 01번 패널에서 시작해 14개 패널을 모두 엄격한 순서로 따라가도록 지시하여 일관된 멀티샷 시퀀스를 만드세요.  
영상 전체에서 동일한 medium/brushwork/texture/color grading/painterly finish가 일관되게 유지되도록 Seedance에 명시적으로 지시해 시각적 연속성을 고정하세요.  
“only the same mermaid”라고 지정하고, 정체성 고정 요소(face, crown, hair, costume, tail, colors, proportions)를 나열해 모든 샷에서 정확히 동일하게 유지되도록 하여 캐릭터 드리프트를 방지하세요.  
비디오가 완전히 underwater 상태를 유지하고, 스토리보드의 정확한 환경 요소(shipwreck, reefs, currents, particles, depth, lighting)를 보존하도록 요구해 장면 일관성을 제어하세요.  
“underwater action cinematographer”와 함께 현실적인 underwater inertia, pursuit tracking, whip-pans, sweeping orbits, obstacle weaving, continuous focus 같은 구체적인 카메라 움직임을 프롬프트로 넣어 카메라 동작을 지시하세요.  
샷별 타임스탬프와 카메라 액션(Shot 01–14, 0–30s 타이밍)을 정의하고 전환 스타일 변화(1–8샷은 hard cuts, 9–10샷은 더 부드럽게, 11–14샷은 더 느린 cinematic transitions)를 지정해 페이싱을 개선하세요.  
“No neon lighting or bioluminescent colors.” 같은 명시적인 negative를 추가해 원치 않는 lighting/style artifact를 피하세요.  
먼저 GPT Image 2로 번호가 매겨진 14패널 그리드(3행 x 5열)를 만들고, 얇은 검은 테두리와 패널 번호를 넣은 뒤, 이를 Seedance video generation의 가이드로 사용하세요.

pt.content:
Use o Seedance 2.5 prompt-to-video com um token de referência de storyboard (por exemplo, @[Imag]) e instrua-o a começar do painel 01 e seguir todos os 14 painéis em ordem estrita para uma sequência multi-shot coerente.  
Trave a continuidade visual dizendo explicitamente ao Seedance para manter o mesmo medium/pincelada/textura/color grading/acabamento pictórico consistentes durante todo o vídeo.  
Evite deriva de personagem especificando “only the same mermaid” e listando travas de identidade (rosto, coroa, cabelo, figurino, cauda, cores, proporções) para permanecerem exatas em todos os shots.  
Controle a consistência da cena exigindo que o vídeo permaneça inteiramente subaquático e preserve os elementos exatos do ambiente do storyboard (naufrágio, recifes, correntes, partículas, profundidade, iluminação).  
Direcione o comportamento da câmera com o prompt “underwater action cinematographer” mais movimentos concretos (inércia subaquática realista, tracking de perseguição, whip-pans, órbitas amplas, desvio de obstáculos, foco contínuo).  
Melhore o ritmo definindo timestamps por shot e ações de câmera (Shot 01–14 com timing de 0–30s) e especificando mudanças no estilo de transição (hard cuts para os shots 1–8, transições mais suaves 9–10, transições cinematográficas mais lentas 11–14).  
Evite artefatos indesejados de iluminação/estilo adicionando negativos explícitos como “No neon lighting or bioluminescent colors.”  
Gere primeiro o storyboard com GPT Image 2 usando uma grade numerada de 14 painéis (3 linhas x 5 colunas) com bordas pretas finas e números nos painéis, depois use-o como guia para a geração do vídeo no Seedance.

zh.content:
使用 Seedance 2.5 的 prompt-to-video，并配合分镜参考 token（例如 @[Imag]），指示它从第 01 格开始，严格按照全部 14 格顺序推进，以生成连贯的多镜头序列。  
通过明确要求 Seedance 在整个视频中保持相同的 medium/brushwork/texture/color grading/painterly finish，来锁定视觉连续性。  
通过指定“only the same mermaid”并列出身份锁定项（face, crown, hair, costume, tail, colors, proportions），确保所有镜头中的角色身份完全一致，避免角色漂移。  
通过要求视频始终完全处于水下，并保留分镜中的精确环境元素（shipwreck, reefs, currents, particles, depth, lighting），来控制场景一致性。  
通过提示“underwater action cinematographer”并加入具体运动方式（realistic underwater inertia, pursuit tracking, whip-pans, sweeping orbits, obstacle weaving, continuous focus），来指导镜头行为。  
通过定义每个镜头的时间戳和镜头动作（Shot 01–14，0–30s timing），并指定转场风格变化（shots 1–8 使用 hard cuts，9–10 更平滑，11–14 使用更慢的 cinematic transitions），来优化节奏。  
通过添加明确的负面约束，例如“No neon lighting or bioluminescent colors.”，来避免不需要的光照/风格伪影。  
先使用 GPT Image 2 生成分镜，采用带编号的 14 格网格（3 行 x 5 列），配以细黑边框和格子编号，然后将其作为 Seedance 视频生成的参考指南。
